recipe_version.title: Yucatecan Tikin Xic: Achiote-Citrus Baked Fish with Pickled Red Onions
recipe_version.description: Cod fillets rubbed with achiote paste blended with orange juice, lime, garlic, oregano, and cumin, layered with tomato and green bell pepper slices, baked in a foil packet, and served with habanero-pickled red onions, cilantro, and white rice.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp onions, 1 tsp fish, 1/2 tsp rice

ingredients.name: achiote paste
ingredients.display_name: achiote paste whose label lists annatto, vinegar, spices, garlic, salt, and corn starch

ingredients.name: cod fillets
ingredients.display_name: skinless cod fillets (4 pieces, about 1 inch thick)

steps.title: Pickle the onions
steps.body: Thinly slice the red onion and sliver the habanero. Toss them in a bowl with 1/4 cup lime juice, 1/3 cup orange juice, and 1/2 tsp salt; they pickle through the rest of the recipe, tossed now and then. Slice the tomato and bell pepper, chop the cilantro, and rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F with a rack in the middle, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile blend the achiote paste with the remaining orange and lime juice, the garlic, oregano, cumin, oil, and 1 tsp salt until smooth. Rub it all over the cod on a large sheet of foil set on the sheet pan and leave it while the oven heats.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While the oven heats and the fish bakes (overlap stated): combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Lay the tomato and bell pepper slices over the fish, fold a second sheet of foil over the top, and crimp the edges to seal. Bake until the fish flakes and reads 145 F, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Open the packet, spoon the fish and its juices beside the rice, and top with pickled onions and cilantro.

equipment: blender or small bowl and whisk

Compared with moroccan-chermoula-fish-tagine: achiote and orange, not chermoula with potatoes and olives.
